title: WALTEUR Skill Receipt
description: Content-bound breadcrumb proving a required skill actually fired: it names when it fired, in what phase, which on-disk artifact(s) it produced or touched, and a non-trivial summary of what the discipline concluded. Replaces existence-only breadcrumbs (file present == PASS), which are forgeable with an empty or garbage file.

skill.description: Skill id, matching the 'skill' field in required-skills.json / skill-routing.json.

fired_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2026-07-01T12:00:00Z) marking when the skill ran and produced this receipt.

phase.description: Build phase the skill fired in (e.g. Plan, Build, Review, Ship). Should be a phase the skill is affine to.

artifacts.description: Repo-relative paths to file(s) that must exist on disk as evidence the discipline actually touched something concrete.

summary.description: What the discipline concluded — not a placeholder. Must be at least 40 characters of substantive content.

verdict.description: Optional verdict string (e.g. PASS/FAIL/NOTED). When a manifest entry declares breadcrumb_verdict_key/breadcrumb_pass_value, that key/value pair is checked instead of this field.
